## Automated Report PDF Generator

Scheduled monthly (1st at 9AM) → reads data from Sheets →
Code generates HTML report with tables and summaries →
Converts to PDF → emails to management → archives to Drive.

**Setup:**
1. Set Google Sheets data source
2. Configure HTML-to-PDF API
3. Set Gmail recipients
4. Set Drive archive folder
5. Adjust cron schedule if needed
